Ceiling insulation note below the ฝ้าเพดาน table references 'เหนือฝ้าเพดานใต้หลังคา ชั้น 2' (above the ceiling under the roof, FLOOR 2) despite this being a single-story house per the cover (3 ห้องนอน 2 ห้องน้ำ, no ชั้น2 anywhere else in this house's plans) — recorded verbatim as printed rather than corrected, flagged as boilerplate template text likely reused unedited from a 2-story house in the same series.
